sloka: तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वाल्मीकिरिदमब्रवीत् ।सीतेयं समनुप्राप्ता पत्नी रामस्य धीमतः ।। ७.४९.२१ ॥
transliteration: tāsāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vālmīkiridamabravīt ।sīteyaṁ samanuprāptā patnī rāmasya dhīmataḥ ।। 7.49.21 ॥

translations.english: Having heard their words, Valmiki spoke this: "This is Sita, the wife of the wise Rama, who has arrived."
